title: Task Test Requirements Schema
description: Validates the test requirements object for a single task.

task_id.description: Task identifier this test requirements object belongs to.

unit_required.description: Whether unit tests are required for this task. True for all pure functions, utilities, and isolated backend logic.

unit_tool.description: Unit test framework. Always Vitest — no exceptions.

unit_coverage_target.description: Target code coverage percentage for unit tests. Recommended minimum: 80 for backend logic.

unit_test_file_path.description: Path to the unit test file.

integration_required.description: Whether integration tests are required. True for Server Actions and Route Handlers that interact with the database.

integration_tool.description: Integration test framework. Always Vitest — no exceptions.

integration_test_file_path.description: Path to the integration test file.

e2e_required.description: Whether E2E tests are required. True for complete user-facing flows (pages, forms, interactions).

e2e_tool.description: E2E test framework. Always Playwright — no exceptions.

e2e_test_file_path.description: Path to the Playwright test file.

e2e_flow_description.description: Description of the user flow to be covered by the E2E test. Required when e2e_required is true.
examples: User logs in, navigates to tasks page, creates a new task, verifies it appears in the list
Unauthenticated user attempts to access protected page and is redirected to login

test_data_requirements.description: Description of test data, fixtures, or seed data required to run the tests for this task.

mock_requirements.description: List of external dependencies, services, or modules that need to be mocked in tests.

examples: Prisma client (use in-memory SQLite for integration tests)

test_notes.description: Additional testing guidance for the dev agent. Include edge cases, boundary conditions, or test setup details.
